fields.contract: SqlShardSets : ShardSetsBase<SqlShardConnectionOptions> is the library facade for SQL Server shard sets configured through SqlShardConnectionOptions. It exposes two constructors: (1) a public constructor SqlShardSets(IOptions<SqlShardConnectionOptions> configOptions, IOptions<SqlGlobalPropertiesOptions>? globalOptions, ILogger<SqlShardSets>? logger) that delegates to the protected constructor with a new SqlClient DataProviderServiceFactory (new DataProviderServiceFactory()), and (2) a protected constructor protected SqlShardSets(IOptions<SqlShardConnectionOptions> configOptions, IDataProviderServiceFactory services, IOptions<SqlGlobalPropertiesOptions>? globalOptions, ILogger<SqlShardSets>? logger) that forwards the caller-supplied IDataProviderServiceFactory and globalOptions?.Value to ShardSetsBase<SqlShardConnectionOptions> for derived classes and test doubles.
